buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Special Term and Conditions 1. Each bidder has to upload & quote the price for only desired Godrej Furniture. 2. The Model/Manufacturing year of Furniture should be latest (i.e. 2026 make). 3. Dealer/Showroom of the Supplier/Agency must be located in Delhi-NCR for sake of Deli very etc. 4. Bidder should have minimum experience of 1 year in dealing with sale ofG odrej Furnit ure and should have minimum average Turnover of Rs. 4 Lakhs in last three (3) years.

5. The Bidder should have valid Authorised dealership of “Original Manufacturer” of br and offered for supply in Tender/Bid (i.e. Godrej Furniture). 6. All legal disputes are subjected to the jurisdiction of Faridabad Court (Haryana) only. 7. Following Documents are to be submitted by Bidder. a) Copy of Goods & Services Tax Identification No. (GSTIN). b) Copy of Authorized Service Partner or Dealership Certificate. c) Minimum Average Annual Turnover Certificate of Rs. 4 Lakhs in the last Three (3) Financ ial Years. d) Copy of Work Order / Supply Order/ Completion Certificate in support of Past Experience . 8. Period of validity of Bid A) The bid should remain valid for a period of 120 Days from the date of opening of the bi d. In case the validity given is for a lesser period, the Bid shall be treated as non responsive . B) In exceptional circumstances, the NPTI may solicit the Bidders’ consent to an extension of the bid validity period. The request and responses thereto shall be made in writing. If a B idder accepts to prolong the period of validity, the bid security shall also be suitably extend ed. A Bidder may refuse the request without forfeiting its bid security. A Bidder granting th e request will not be required nor permitted to modify its bid. 9. Banning of Business Dealings It is not in the interest of NPTI to deal with suppliers/Agencies who commit deception, fraud or other misconduct in the tendering process. The grounds on which Banning of Business D ealings can be initiated are as follows: i) If the security consideration, including questions of loyalty of the Agency to NPTI so war rants; ii) If the owner of the Agency, proprietor or partner of the firm, is convicted by a court of l aw for offences involving moral turpitude in relation to its business dealings with the Gover nment or any other public sector enterprises, during last five years; iii) If the Central Vigilance Commission, Central Bureau of Investigation or any other Centr al Government investigation Agency recommends such a course in respect of a case under investigation or improper conduct on agency’s part. iv) On any other ground upon which business dealings with the Agency is not in the public i nterest. v) If business dealings with the Agency have been banned by the Ministry of Power, Govern ment of India OR any PSU/ any other authority under the MOP if intimated to NPTI or availa ble on MOP Website, the business dealing with such agencies shall be banned with immedi ate effect for future business dealing. 10. Modifications Prior to the date of Bid opening NPTI reserves the right itself to postpone and /or extend the date of receipt or to withdraw t he Bid notice, with assigning a suitable reason thereof, entirely at its discretion. In such an event, bidders shall not be entitled to any compensation, in any from whatsoever. 11. The purchase covered by this Bid specification shall be executed strictly in accordance with the conditions specified in the “Term & Conditions of Contract” and other conditio

ns specified in various sections of this Bid document. Bidders are requested to submit their offer strictly in line with terms and conditions of tender specification, otherwise bid may be rejected. Bids silent regarding any of the terms or specifications shall be presumed to be co nfirming to the specifications and terms & conditions as stipulated in this Bid document. 12. Cancelation/Withdrawl Invitation of Bid. NPTI reserves the right to accept or reject any bid, or cancel/ withdraw invitation to Bid for any reason including National Defence /security conditions/ or annul the Bidding process/ r eject all bids at any time prior to the award of supply order, without thereby incurring any li ability to the affected Bidder or Bidders. However, the Bidder(s), who wish to seek reasons f or such decision of cancellation/ rejection, shall be informed by NPTI unless its disclosure re asonably could be expected to affect the sovereignty and integrity of India, the security, an d strategic, scientific or economic interest of the State, relation with foreign state or lead to incitement of an offence. 13. Negotiations. The institute reserves the right to accept or reject any or all of the bids. The Institute also r eserves the right to negotiate / seek justification of the rate quoted by L-1 Bidder. 14. Penalty Clause If the supplier fails to deliver and installation of the items on or before the stipulated, perio d/date, a penalty @ 1% per week of the total order value shall be levied subject to maximum of 10% of the total order value. However, NPTI also reserve the right to can cel/terminate the order if the supplier fails to deliver the supply within the stipulated time p rovided. 15. Delivery Instructions Delivery of the all furniture items to Consignee at Office Building, NPTI Complex, Sector-33, Faridabad, Haryana. 16. Payment Terms & Conditions 100% Payment will be released against successful delivery of Godrej Furniture by the Agen cy. Payment shall be made within 30 days of submission of bills; however, no interest shall be payable for any delay in payment, regardless of the reason. .
